title: Discord Whitelist
description: Link your Discord to play. Leave the Discord, get kicked.
body:
DiscordWhitelist forces players to link their Minecraft account to your Discord server before they can join. No verification, no access — simple as that.
How it works

Players join your Discord and use the /verify <pseudo> slash command. The plugin automatically links their account and lets them in. If they leave the Discord, they get kicked instantly and their account is unlinked.
Features

🔗 Discord verification — Players must be in your Discord to join the server

🔒 IP locking — Each username is locked to its first connection IP, preventing account theft on cracked servers

👢 Auto-kick — Players are kicked in real-time if they leave the Discord or lose a required role

🎭 Role support — Optionally require a specific Discord role to access the server

✅ Auto role — Automatically assign a Discord role upon successful verification

⚙️ Admin commands — /dwl unlink, /dwl resetip, /dwl check, /dwl status and more

🗄️ SQLite storage — Lightweight local database, no MySQL required

🚀 No external process — The Discord bot runs directly inside the plugin, no separate bot 
hosting needed

Compatible with Paper/Purpur 1.21+ — Cracked & premium servers
